text:
maria-plat: Quick check — Snowpeak VPC preflight status. Customer says they've submitted firewall egress list (ticket 3421). Can someone confirm prod CIDR and whether we need a bastion SSH exception?

alex-net: I saw ticket 3421. The IPs there look like staging ranges. @raj-eng can you confirm prod subnet?

raj-eng: Prod subnet is 10.12.0.0/16, confirmed with customer doc. We should use NAT for outbound; customer prefers no direct internet for model pulls. Airgap flow needs to be validated.

liz-ops: We're still waiting on the signed AUP + registry mirror creds from Snowpeak. I sent the template last night. No SFTP creds yet.

tim-sre: For canary we'll run 2 nodes with healthchecks on /healthz. Runbook command to check rollout: `kubectl -n redwood rollout status deploy/snowpeak-inference`.

maria-plat: customer wants cutover Friday. @alex-net what's ETA on firewall rules if we give the final CIDRs?

alex-net: I can push rules by Thu 18:00 PT if nothing changes. Need a sec reviewer before apply. @sec-jane?

sec-jane: Quick sec note — bastion must only allow 22/443 from customer CIDR + our mgmt CIDR. Block HTTP from internet. Also need AS path validation for their VPN. :warning:

alex-net: ack, will follow that.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] preflight-checks: 14/18 passed — bastion cert missing SAN entries, expires: 2025-08-02.

raj-eng: I can rotate certs but need access to their vault or a signed cert bundle. @liz-ops any update on access?

liz-ops: Customer refused vault access. They offered signed cert bundle via secure SFTP only. We need SFTP creds and host fingerprints.

maria-plat: Action items: (1) alex apply firewall by Thu 18:00 PT; (2) liz get SFTP creds + signed AUP; (3) raj prepare cert rotation steps; (4) tim schedule canary window 02:00-04:00 UTC Fri; (5) I'll coordinate cutover announcement. I'll update the runbook after preflight.

alex-net: noted and pinging sec for review.

raj-eng: small infra ask — KV cache needs +2GB for model KV during canary. Opening PR to infra config.

raj-eng: PR created: https://git.redwood/snowpeak/infra/pulls/1289

tim-sre: lgtm on PR, left one minor comment about limits.

maria-plat: final check — image delivery plan for airgapped hosts? What's fallback if SFTP transfer fails?

liz-ops: documented in runbook v1.2 — primary: SFTP transfer with checksums; fallback: customer will ship encrypted USB with signed manifest. We have checksum and verification steps.

maria-plat: perfect. I'll do a final preflight Thu 20:00 PT and post a short status update. :thumbsup:

sec-jane: one more — confirm log shipping method (syslog/our agent) before cutover. No plaintext logs to their public buckets.

raj-eng: we'll use our agent with TLS to their collector over the private link. I'll add that to the runbook.

maria-plat: thanks all. If anything else pops up, drop it here and I'll triage.
